copy: Sign out of your Conductor account.

items.name: Conductor root directory
copy: Where Conductor stores repositories and workspaces. This should be an empty directory that you don't modify directly.

items.name: Claude Code executable path
copy: Override the bundled Claude Code executable with a custom one. Leave empty to use the bundled version (recommended).

items.name: Codex executable path
copy: Override the bundled Codex executable with a custom one. Leave empty to use the bundled version (recommended).

items.name: OpenCode executable path
copy: Override the bundled OpenCode executable with a custom one. Leave empty to use the bundled version (recommended).

items.name: SSH private key path
copy: Use your own SSH key for cloud workspace access. Leave empty to auto-generate a key.

items.name: Remote execution MCP
copy: Let remote agents request approved one-shot commands on this Mac. Each command still requires your approval.

items.name: Always allow local commands
copy: Run local commands from remote agents without asking. Turned on when you choose Yes always on a local command approval.

items.name: Enable file sync in new cloud workspaces
copy: Enable file sync in new cloud workspaces
Start syncing when you open a local terminal or run a local task. Sync files can still be turned on per workspace.

items.name: Set upstream on plain git push
copy: Set upstream on plain git push
Configure new Conductor workspaces so plain git push sets a branch upstream. Turning this off avoids writing Git worktree config, but PR info may be less reliable until branches have an upstream.

items.name: Big terminal mode
copy: Create big terminals in the center pane with ⌘⇧T

items.name: Tab Freak Mode
copy: Allow up to 10 chat and terminal tabs per workspace.

items.name: Split tabs
copy: Split the center panel and move tabs between panes.

items.name: Fork chat to new tab
copy: Fork a chat, even mid-turn, from its tab's context menu or with ⌘⌥↵.

items.name: In-app browser preview
copy: Open the preview button in an in-app browser tab (with the annotation overlay) instead of your external browser.

items.name: Use legacy file preview and editing
copy: Use legacy file preview and editing

items.name: Show agent cost
copy: Show estimated agent costs for cloud workspaces.

items.name: Workspace status matrix
copy: Use the matrix-style workspace status indicator in Home and the sidebar.

items.name: Cloud desktop
copy: Show Cloud desktop tabs in cloud workspaces.

items.name: Add projects without GitHub
copy: Let Conductor add existing local repositories even when they are not connected to GitHub.

items.name: Auto-run after setup
copy: Start a repository's run script automatically after a new local workspace finishes setup.

items.name: Dashboard
copy: Show the dashboard and workspace sidebar.

items.name: Voice mode
copy: Enables speech-to-text in the chat composer. Press Ctrl+Shift+D to start dictating.

items.name: Show sidebar resource usage
copy: Shows CPU and memory usage in the workspace sidebar footer.

items.name: Sidebar transparency
copy: Use native macOS vibrancy behind the workspace sidebar. Takes effect after you restart Conductor.

items.name: Graphite stack support
copy: Detect Graphite stacks for the active local workspace and show stack-aware UI in the git panel. Cloud workspaces are unaffected. When off, Conductor never runs the gt CLI.

items.name: Send messages with
copy: Choose which key combination sends messages

items.name: Follow-up behavior
copy: Queue messages to send after the agent finishes, or steer the agent mid-turn.

items.name: Agent notifications
copy: Get notified when an agent finishes working.

items.name: @ notifications
copy: Get notified when a teammate mentions you.

items.name: Completion sound
copy: Choose what plays when AI finishes working in a chat.

copy: To let agents work without repeated folder permission prompts.

items.name: Always show context usage
copy: Always show context usage. By default, it is only shown when more than 70% is used.

items.name: Caffeinate while agents are running
copy: Prevent your Mac from sleeping while an agent is actively working. Shuts off below 10% battery.

items.name: Workspace API access
copy: Give new workspaces access to the Conductor API

items.name: Show MCP status in chat
copy: Show a per-session MCP server status indicator in the composer.

items.name: Don't collapse tool calls (Garry Mode)
copy: Show all tool calls expanded by default instead of collapsed.

items.name: Sync agent configs
copy: Copy skills, slash commands, and MCP servers between Claude Code and Codex.

items.name: Git identity
copy: Name and email used for commits in cloud workspaces.

items.name: Branch new workspaces from
copy: Each workspace is an isolated copy of your codebase.

copy: Prefix for new workspace branch names.

Automatically rename workspaces from their placeholder city name to the branch name generated from the first message.

items.name: Delete branch on archive
copy: Delete the local branch when archiving a workspace. To delete the remote branch, configure it on GitHub.

items.name: Archive on merge
copy: Automatically archive a workspace after merging its PR in Conductor

items.name: Automerge
copy: Show an automerge button in the git panel when checks are pending. Requires automerge to be enabled in your GitHub repository settings. Automerge is not supported for stacked pull requests.

items.name: Treat optional checks as blocking
copy: Hide the merge button when any check has failed, including checks GitHub considers optional.

items.name: Set upstream on plain git push
copy: Set upstream on plain git push
Configure new Conductor workspaces so plain git push sets a branch upstream. Turning this off avoids writing Git worktree config, but PR info may be less reliable until branches have an upstream.

items.name: Use GitHub stacked PRs
copy: Instruct agents that they can use `gh stack` for PR stacking.

items.name: Exclusive port forwarding
copy: Turning on port forwarding in one workspace turns it off everywhere else

items.name: Forwarding strategies
copy: How new forwards choose their local port. Existing forwards keep their ports.

items.name: Local port range
copy: Used for forwards that don't match their remote port number.

items.name: Use workspace tabs
copy: Show open workspaces as browser-style tabs across the top of the window, after a fixed Home tab. Only applies in team organizations.

items.name: Initial Claude permission mode
copy: Set the native Claude permission mode for new local Claude sessions. Inherit preserves the existing Conductor behavior.

items.name: Initial Codex approval policy and sandbox
copy: Initial Codex approval policy and sandbox
Set native Codex approval policy and sandbox values for new local Codex sessions. Inherit preserves the existing Conductor behavior.

items.name: Build commit
copy: The commit this build was made from.

items.name: Log viewer
copy: Open the app log viewer for this Conductor instance.

items.name: Onboarding
copy: Open the real onboarding flows the way new users see them. Anything you change inside them is saved.

items.name: New member onboarding state
copy: Treat a shared org's membership as not onboarded: the org switcher shows the switch callout, and switching to the org shows new member onboarding. Cleared on relaunch. Reset forgets which orgs' callouts were dismissed on this Mac.

items.name: Terminal render debug log
copy: Log raw terminal input/output and renderer events through the app logger.

items.name: Frame drop logging
copy: Log any frame that takes more than 200ms to render through the app logger, to help diagnose UI freezes. Will prevent app from going idle, might increase battery + CPU usage.

items.name: Cloud file sync trigger
copy: Choose whether cloud file sync polls or waits for workspace change signals.

items.name: Keep cloud workspaces independent from local repositories
copy: Keep cloud workspaces independent from local repositories
Prevent cloud workspaces from attaching to matching repositories on this Mac.

items.name: Request metadata
copy: Show requested and returned model/runtime metadata in the context hover card and turn tooltips.

items.name: Claude token usage tracking
copy: Track Claude token usage totals, show them in context usage, and log turn totals to Honeycomb.

items.name: Verbose logging
copy: Enable extra diagnostic logs in the frontend, Rust host, and sidecar.

items.name: Tauri HTTP proxy
copy: Route native Tauri HTTP requests through a local proxy. Applies immediately to requests made through the shared Tauri fetch wrapper. Leave blank to disable.

items.name: Save workspace session logs
copy: Persist frontend-ingested session events on disk.

items.name: Crash test
copy: Trigger a crash to validate error reporting in Sentry.

items.name: Error reporting test
copy: Trigger logged, request-scoped, and async errors in Roundhouse and a ready cloud workspace.

items.name: Agent binaries
copy: Re-download the pinned Claude / Codex binary, and inject artificial failures to exercise the retry UI. Failure counts are in-memory only — they reset on app restart.

copy: Default to plan mode in new chats

items.name: Code ligatures

items.name: Theme

items.name: Low-contrast dark mode

items.name: App zoom
copy: Adjust the size of the Conductor interface.

items.name: Accessible colors

items.name: Code theme
